meta.title: Bundled ICAR fertilizer recommendations
meta.gradeSource: Standard nutrient grades used for fertilizer calculations: urea 46% N, DAP 18% N + 46% P₂O₅, MOP 60% K₂O. Product quantities are calculated from nutrient targets; actual product labels may vary.
meta.coverageNote: Bundled entries are source-backed crop and region recommendations, not a complete state-by-crop matrix. Unconfigured combinations must use the local Soil Health Card/KVK dose; never infer a rate from another region.
